items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency/supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Data quality is yellow because analytics source permissions or collector errors exist. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, allow only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, or external exposure, and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, deploy, requeue failures, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
